$comment: Licence choices a person made, for packages whose metadata or files cannot say it alone (scripts/third-party-notices.mjs).
'licence' replaces the id package.json declares; 'files' replaces the licence files found at the package's top level; 'extraFiles' adds files from deeper in it; 'note' is printed above the text.
'buildOnly' names packages in package.json's dependencies that only run at build time; nothing of theirs reaches the bundle, so they and what only they pull in are left out.

dompurify.note: DOMPurify is dual-licensed MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0. Initiative takes it under Apache-2.0.

khroma.note: khroma's package.json declares no licence; the licence file it ships is MIT.

pdfjs-dist.note: pdf.js's image decoders are WebAssembly builds of other projects; their licences follow its own, and also ship beside them in assets/pdfjs-wasm/.
